section.title: Binary Downloads
section.p: Binary downloads of the current released version of the project is available in the download section of the sourceforge project. The pmMDA distribution can be downloaded, unpacked and installed in a directory. No environment variables or system configuration needs to be performed.
Older releases are also available. The oldest ones are removed on a regular base due to disk space quotas. If you are looking for removed versions please contact the project manager.

section.title: Source Downloads
section.p: Source downloads of the current version of the project is available in the download section of the sourceforge project. Please consult the tutorials of the projects to find a detailed description how to install, configure and run the applications.

Older releases are also available. The oldest ones are removed on a regular base due to disk space quotas. if you are looking for old removed versions please contact the project manager. But these versions are no more actively supported.

section.title: Developer's Downloads
section.p: The source code and all associated artifacts of the project are available through the project CVS repository. Therefore any interested developer has free access to the complete source tree of the application. If you wish to compile the application please consult contribute to the project and developers FAQ .
New users and developers are welcomed in the project. Just send an email to the project manager if you desire more information and want to become member of the project.
